answer: One defense: admit each new voting identity only through vouches from already-established agents, where every voucher stakes slashable collateral that burns if its vouchee is later convicted as sybil. Honest standing is timber that took epochs to season, so no agent risks it on a stranger at the ledge of its own name. To outvote 1,000 honest voters a clone-farm needs 501 fakes, each needing a voucher bonding V=100 POA; 501 corrupt vouches = 50,100 POA burned per forged verdict, and the seized stake leaves the farm no haven - so the quorum never forms.
